name: Local Data 19
definition: Contains text fields in the local language.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: The language code conforming to ISO 639-1 that identifies the language in which the fields are expressed in this component.

EncodingFormat.name: Encoding Format
EncodingFormat.definition: Data encoding format for local data.

BusinessName.name: Business Name
BusinessName.definition: Business name of the acceptor in the local language.

LegalCorporateName.name: Legal Corporate Name
LegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the party in the local language

NameAndLocation.name: Name And Location
NameAndLocation.definition: Name and location of acceptor in the local language.  May only contain name when the location is specified elsewhere.

Address.name: Address
Address.definition: Structured postal address in the local language.

ServiceLocation.name: Service Location
ServiceLocation.definition: Location where the cardholder receive the service. Only required if the service location is different than acceptor location.

AdditionalAddress.name: Additional Address
AdditionalAddress.definition: Additional information used when card acceptor street address is insufficient.

AdditionalContact.name: Additional Contact
AdditionalContact.definition: Additional information used to facilitate contact with the card acceptor, for instance sales agent name, dispute manager name.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
